notes: Built once from the kenney.nl asset listing (14 pages) and, for 3D/Audio/Textures packs, each pack page (count and tags). kenney.nl/robots.txt disallows automated access to /assets/ and blocks AI agents by name, so do NOT refresh this automatically and do NOT fetch kenney.nl from tools. The user downloads a pack by clicking Download on the pack page (no account, a donation prompt can be skipped). 2D packs have count null (not read). Every Kenney pack is CC0 (each zip has License.txt).
zip_layout: Checked on one 3D pack (Mini Characters, 4 MB zip): Models/GLB format/*.glb (plus Models/FBX format, Models/OBJ format, Models/Textures/), Previews/*.png (one per model), Preview.png, Overview.html, License.txt. 2D, audio and texture packs were not opened: list the zip (unzip -l) before using it; 2D packs usually hold PNG files and often a spritesheet. The GLBs in that pack point to an external texture (Textures/colormap.png next to the .glb): keep that folder beside the model or embed it (gltf-transform copy/optimize). Its characters carry 32 animation clips (idle, walk, sprint, jump, fall...).
